login_forgot: Forgot it? The serial console shows it at every boot.
no_wifi: Not connected to a Wi-Fi network.
waiting_sensor: {n} waiting for a window sensor to wake up
no_rooms: No device has a room yet. Only devices with a room control the furnace and appear in Home Assistant. Open one from the list below and give it a room.
other_devices_hint: Without a room: not part of heating, not in Home Assistant.
badge_unconfirmed_hint: Settings sent but not acknowledged yet; sent again when the device is heard.
badge_no_answer_hint: The device got no answer from a link partner. Re-link its room, or check the partner's batteries.
no_answer_partner: got no answer from a link partner
sent_again_heard: (sent again when the device is heard)
forget_confirm: Forget {name}? It is unlinked from the others and removed from Home Assistant.
type_unknown_hint: The bridge has only heard this device answer others, which does not say what it is. Set the type so it can be linked and, for a radiator thermostat, count for heating.
room_hint: Devices with a room drive the furnace, get the time from the bridge, and appear in Home Assistant. In a room the bridge links the thermostats and window sensors to each other: radiator thermostats then follow the wall thermostat and close when a window opens. Leave the room empty for devices that are not yours.
factory_reset_device_confirm: Factory reset {name}? It forgets its pairing, links and settings. Then hold boost on it: it pairs again and gets its room's settings back.
factory_reset_device_sent: Reset sent. Now hold boost on the device until it counts down.
relink_sent: Sending the room's links again. Window sensors get theirs the next time they are opened or closed.
control_sent: Sent. The device confirms on its next message.
wp_needs_point: needs at least one switch point
wp_too_many: devices hold at most {n} switch points
wp_five_minutes: times must be in 5 minute steps
wp_same_time: two switch points at the same time
wp_default: The bridge has not set a program on this device yet, so this shows the default: comfort from 6:00, eco from 22:00. The device keeps its own until you save.
wp_hint: Each time is when its temperature starts; the last one holds until the first one the next day.
restarting_hint: After a Wi-Fi change, connect this device to that network too: the board will be at
not_back: The board did not come back here.
not_back_hint: It probably joined another network: look for it at
not_back_hotspot: If it cannot join, its setup hotspot comes back within about a minute.
ha_hint: Devices with a room appear as thermostats, window sensors and so on; the bridge adds the furnace and a pairing switch.
pairing_how: Put the device into pairing mode (on most, hold the boost button until the display counts down); it then shows up under Devices, where you give it a name and a room.
pairing_hint: For new devices only: those paired to this bridge's radio address already work. Pairing stops by itself after 5 minutes.
radio_hint: Devices only listen to the address they were paired to: to take over from a MAX! Cube or another bridge, use its address. The frequency correction makes up for this CC1101 module's crystal error; measure it from the thermostats' packets:
duty_cycle: Keep to the 1 % duty cycle of the 868 MHz band (airtime left {s} s)
heating_hint: The burner follows the most-open valve: at {cycle} minute cycles, a valve 60 % open runs it {share} minutes per cycle, one at 100 % all the time. Boost runs it continuously.
time_hint: Thermostats run their week programs on the time the bridge sends them.
eu_dst: EU summer time (last Sunday of March to last Sunday of October)
time_saved: Saved and sent to the thermostats.
readings_disagree: Readings disagree by {n} steps; wait for more.
turn_wheel: Turn a thermostat wheel to send one.
running_from: Running from {slot} ({state}). Build the image with
fw_rollback_hint: A new image goes back to the previous one by itself if it keeps crashing or cannot get onto the network within 10 minutes.
backup_hint: One file with all settings and devices: rooms, temperatures, week programs and the radio address they are paired to. It contains the Wi-Fi and MQTT passwords, so keep it private. The device password is not in it: a restore keeps the current one.
not_backup: That file is not a max2mqtt backup.
restore_confirm: Replace all settings and devices with the backup ({n} devices{wifi})? The board restarts and sends every device its settings again.
not_back_short: The board did not come back here.
factory_confirm: Erase all settings and devices? The board restarts with its setup hotspot and the default password.
crashes_hint: The board restarted after these. Turn the addresses into source lines with fw-crash and the ELF of that version.
no_crashes: None recorded. A crash restarts the board and shows up here.
